dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
So... Is this the trespasser?
所以……这是入侵者？

The child's voice was rather dry.
孩子的声音相当干燥。

With an apathetic expression and voice, he was looking down at the person dragged in front of him.
他的表情和声音无动于衷，就这样低头看着那个人从他眼前被带走。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
Yes, sir. They might have been trying to loot Enkephalin from the facility... They came down to the underground alone.
没错。他可能是想偷走设施的脑啡肽……才独自一人来到了支部的地下。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
...I see, you may go now.
……明白了，退下吧。

Perhaps that's the child's subordinate. The member who dragged the person with bound arms into the room bowed to the child before walking away.
也许他是那孩子的下属。把被绑着胳膊的人拖进房间的成员向孩子鞠了一躬，然后便离开了。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
Now... You may begin talking. For what reason did you go to that place?
现在……你可以开始说话了。为什么要去那里？

As the fan folded shut, the captured one started arguing in their defense.
当扇子合上后，被抓到的人便开始为自己辩护。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
A-Are you their leader?
你、你是他们的老大吗？

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
...It does happen to be my current position.
……目前，姑且算是这样。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
Look... I'm risking my life trying to earn some cash. It's not like you rented this whole facility to yourselves or anything, does it hurt to share some of that?
不是……你们没买下那座支部，而我也是冒着生命危险下来赚钱的，稍微分享一点都觉得可惜吗？

The child's expression becomes further unconcerned. He seemed almost puzzled by the claim.
孩子的表情似乎变得更加无所谓。看上去像是不理解那人说的话。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
It appears to me that you may have a misunderstanding...
或许你有所误解……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
I'm not misunderstanding a thing! I saw that fancy lab you've set up here, too... What, I guess there wasn't any Enkephalin left here that you could pocket, huh?
有什么误解！既然你们连这么个光鲜亮丽的实验室都建起来了……算了，反正这里应该也没剩下什么能给我装进口袋的脑啡肽了？

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
That is not an installation meant for harvesting Enkephalin...
这里，并非为收集脑啡肽而建立的设施……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
What else can it be!
那该是什么！

*Shrft*
沙。

The child forcefully unfolded his fan, making his unwillingness to hear more of it clear.
孩子像是不愿再听一样，一把将扇子展开。

The complaining person stopped their argument for a second, overwhelmed by the sound and the pungent scent emitted with it.
先前还满怀不满说着话的那人，也被开扇声和刺鼻的香气所震慑，一下把话咽了回去。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
W-What. Now that I got a closer look, you seem strange. There are flowers on your head, and...
干……干什么。仔细一看你，长得可真奇怪。头上还开着花……

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
These... are bloomed things.
这是……盛放之物。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
The nostalgia in my mind for a certain time I would like to summon forth has taken form.
曾几何时……我心中试图唤回的乡愁，凝聚成此种形态。

Facing the perplexed expression, the child stands up and slowly walks toward them.
面对那人困惑的表情，孩子起身缓步接近。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
Eek, s-stay away!
噫，别、别过来！

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
There is no need to fear. You admitted yourself that you're risking your life.
无需恐惧。你，先前说过自己赌上了性命？

The child doesn't seem to have any hostile intent. Rather, he seemed as if his eyes were set on something far, far away.
孩子看上去并没有任何攻击的想法。不如说他似乎在眺望着遥远的，渺远的某处。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
If I may ask... Have you seen a proper flower in recent times?
你最近……是否见过真正的花？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
...I don't think... I've seen any in person. Artificial ones were everywhere, though.
……我觉得……大概没有直接见过。人造花倒是看过太多。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
Indeed... Technology has come to a point where it robs us of what originally brought us enjoyment and glee.
是……技术终于夺走了我们曾经以之为乐，为之欢笑的事物。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
One day... in our pursuit of convenience and expediency, we'd lost what used to matter more than technology.
终有一天……将会失去。为追求方便与快捷，而忽视比技术更为重要的东西。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
If it weren't for such technologies, you would not be living the life of a petty Enkephalin thief, is that not right?
若是没有所谓技术，你如今也不会这样四处盗窃脑啡肽吧？

The captured person seemed to be flustered by the child's question, rolling their eyes for a bit.
孩子的话令被抓住的那人睁大眼睛，十分困惑。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
No, but still...
不，但是……

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
If it weren't for technology, I wouldn't be alive at all by now... though?
如果连技术都没了，我的命也压根得不到保障……吧？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
My life was saved by some ampule K Corp. made once, even though it cost me an arm and a leg...
虽然价格高得离谱，但是多亏了K公司出品的那个安瓶还是安瓿的，我才捡回了一条命……

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟

dataList.content:
The child briefly contemplated in silence...
孩子一时失语，随后像是想起了什么……

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
Indeed, you raise a fair point.
是，你所说亦是正解。

Then he gave his reply with a snicker.
他笑着回答。

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
What?
啊？

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
Although I happened to be assigned the position of a leader... My goal is slightly different from what they chant in unison.
不知缘由，我虽已经自诩为这些人的领导者之一……但我的目标与他们略有不同。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
When an artificial flower was first made, when fireworks were first invented...
当第一朵人造花卉被制作之时，当第一束烟火被研制之时……

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
The pure delight and joy of witnessing them emerge for the first time in the world.
这些曾经从未存在的事物首次出现在世上时，只会感到纯粹的欢愉与喜悦。

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
Do you not yearn for that feeling as well?
你是否也想品味这种滋味？

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.teller:
Captured Thief
被抓住的小偷
dataList.content:
...You're not right in your mind, are you?
……你，脑袋有问题吗？

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
You may be correct in your judgement. Yet...
或许你所说也是一种正解。而……

dataList.title:
Technology Liberation Alliance
技术解放联盟
dataList.content:
That path appears quite charming to me. And, I felt my mind bloom wider than ever as I conceived that idea.
我认为那条道路绚丽无比。因而，每当浮现出那想法，我内心的绽放便比任何时候都更为繁盛。

The child's mind was clear and steadfast.
那孩子的心是坚定且清晰的。

It seemed that no one could dare snap it.
似乎不论是谁，都无法使其折损。
